annotations.title: Query Historical Ledger & Pin Expected Schema Hashes

description: Retrieve historical conformance observations and manage pinned SHA-256 tools/list policy hashes in the Assay ledger for a target endpoint. When expected_tools_hash is provided, it pins that 64-hex digest as the target's baseline policy and compares it against the latest stored observation; when omitted, it returns the stored dossier and last 20 drift observations without network probing unless the target is unindexed. Idempotent; first 5 calls/IP are free. Use to audit historical drift or pin mcp-lock.json hashes; for live pre-execution gating use assay_preflight; for live re-indexing use assay_probe; for post-payment SLA receipts use assay_verify_delivery. Example: target='https://agentdiet-72343955726.us-central1.run.app/mcp'.

expected_tools_hash.description: Optional 64-char SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical MCP tools/list schema from mcp-lock.json. Omit to read or auto-pin the current live digest; pass a 64-hex digest to enforce zero-drift gating.

target.description: Public HTTPS URL of the remote MCP server, A2A agent, or x402 endpoint to inspect (e.g. 'https://tandem.ac/mcp'). Private and loopback IPs are blocked.

name: assay_get_ledger_policy
